description: Land Acquisition - Pitawala, Ambagamuwa D/S Division, Korale, Nuwaraeliya District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land lots, their boundaries, extents, and the process for compensation claims. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns government acquisition of land and property-related matters for public purposes.
